task_name: Take bread slices from a bag, deal them onto paper plates and stack
task: The person takes slices of brown bread out of a plastic bread bag, deals them one by one onto several white paper plates, and moves slices between plates to stack them.

objects.properties: soft, light and floppy; it bends when lifted by an edge

objects.properties: light, thin and stiff, with a raised rim

objects.description: the clear plastic bag the bread comes in, with a printed label
several slices lying on top of each other on a plate
